name: identify_file
title: Identify File Type
description: Identifies the currently selected data source using ImHex's libmagic database (the same engine the GUI uses), returning a human-readable description, MIME type and likely file extensions. Falls back to a built-in signature table. Much stronger than detect_file_type; prefer this tool.

description.description: libmagic human-readable description, or empty if the magic database is unavailable

magic_bytes.description: Uppercase hex of the first bytes
